verdict.absent_note: ha-fab and ha-textfield are not required by the PRD's UI spec; they were probed speculatively. Their absence only means the panel must not reach for them.
verdict.runtime_spike_status: The static half of P1 is done and is the half that answers 'does this component exist on this version'. The runtime half, registering a panel and confirming each element resolves through customElements.whenDefined after the card-helpers force-load, needs a Home Assistant restart and is therefore queued behind Jayant's restart rather than blocking Phase 1 planning.
verdict.tab_note: PRD Section 7.1 says to use ha-tabs or ha-tab-group, whichever exists, detected at runtime. On 2026.8.3 ha-tabs is gone and ha-tab-group is present, so the runtime detection the PRD asked for is still the right shape but has a known answer on this version.
